title: Golden Kamuy
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After the Russo-Japanese War, veteran Saichi Sugimoto hunts for hidden Ainu gold whose map is tattooed on escaped convicts. He teams up with Asirpa, a young Ainu girl seeking the truth about her father, and they race rival soldiers and outlaws across Hokkaido.
life_message: A good life means living rightly with land and people while carrying the weight of war.

content.note: Gunfights, killings, skinning of tattooed convicts, torture (Wikipedia); AniList Gore 78%, Guns, Military.
War trauma and wilderness survival, bear attacks (Wikipedia; AniList Survival).
Comedic nudity and gag fan service (AniList Nudity signal, MangaDex 'suggestive'); LGBTQ+ signal (to verify).
Drinking (Wikipedia: a drunk old man); further drug use (to verify).
Survivor's guilt and war veterans' struggles (Wikipedia themes); AniList Military.
Hunting and butchering animals in an educational frame (AniList Educational).
